utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still on — you can drop supplies at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I’ll drop supplies at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Leo — if you check the flyer, I can help fill in whatever’s still missing for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I’ll check the flyer and see what’s missing for Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo — once you’ve checked it, send me the missing bits and I’ll help fill them in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, do you know what supplies the repair drive still needs most? I can try to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet, but I’d guess it’s safest to bring extra tape, screws, and a few basic tools. If you can, maybe check with the community center first so we don’t end up doubling up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check with the community center first, then bring whatever they still need most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Faye — just let me know what tools you still need, and I can bring them by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check what’s still needed and send you the list before Friday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Faye — just send the list over when you can, and I’ll bring what I’ve got by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yep, it’s the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. I’d double-check the flyer for the exact start time before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll check the flyer. And I’ll get everything to you by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think the flyer had the start time—I'd check that first. If you’re bringing tools, maybe just the basics; I can help sort it out if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can bring the basics. Just let me know if there’s anything else you still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know. The flyer should have the start time, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sorting donations still needs a few hands, and we could use one more person at the garage, too. See you by the garage at 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—sorting donations and one more person at the garage. I’ll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the repair drive and bring back whatever I can find. Then we can sort out the missing bits together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — let me know what you find, and I’ll help sort the missing bits after.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll head over now and report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Oren — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. If you can bring tools, tape, or screws, that would be wonderful by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for the update, Rosa — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll try to bring some tools or tape by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Oren — thank you. I’ll make sure it’s all set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m not sure of the latest list, but I can help sort it out with you. If you know what’s still missing, let’s tackle that first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve heard donations are coming in, but I’m not sure what’s still missing. Want to go over the list together and see what needs fixing most?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, let’s go over it together and see what’s still missing most.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll remind folks the drive still needs tools, screws, and basic supplies, and to drop them off at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — I’ll let folks know to drop off tools, screws, and basic supplies at the community center front desk.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating that and point people to the front desk at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds great, Hana — send me the flyer when you can, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do, Quinn — I’m checking the flyer for the exact start time now, and I’ll send it over as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Hana — I appreciate it. I’ll keep spreading the word and watch for the flyer details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure everyone’s updated. What would be most helpful for you to bring by Friday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone with wire, sealant, or tools your way by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik — that would be a big help. I’ll keep the Sunday community center details circulating, and send folks your way if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yep, that’s the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. I’d double-check the flyer for the exact start time before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Opal — I’ve got it as the Saturday repair drive at the community center. I’ll check the flyer for the exact start time before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — if you want, I can also help keep track of any updates for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still on. I heard we’ve got some good donations already, but they could still use a few more repair items.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — what repair items do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly tools and a few basic parts — if folks can spare those, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m collecting for the repair drive itself, and I need everything by Friday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, Friday works — I’ll get my part to you by then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still sorting the supply list for Saturday morning at the community center. If you know anyone with tools, tape, or spare parts, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can bring my toolbox and some spare tape. Tell me the exact list, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli — that covers the basics for now. I’m still tightening the list, but your toolbox and tape are a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it’s still on. I’m just coordinating around the school schedule so we can line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can help line things up around the school schedule if you need. Just let me know what to organize.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send you the school times, and you can help me line everything up around them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still on for the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you still need volunteers, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but if you know what’s still missing, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah—last I checked, we still needed a couple more volunteers and some basic tools. I can help sort the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara. I can check on a few more volunteers and see if I can round up some basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits, but it sounds like plenty of help is already lined up. If there’s anything still open for the repair drive, I’d love a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact timing and what’s left to cover, so I’d rather not guess. Once I have that, I can help sort the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — thanks for waiting on the details. Just let me know when you have the timing and any open spots, and I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m on it, and I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors too. Just send me the confirmed time and what items you want people to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Quinn. What time is confirmed, and what should people bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll send it as soon as it’s set. For now, tell people to bring any spare tools, screws, tape, and small repair supplies they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: If it’s still on for Saturday morning at the community center, I can help from there. Just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it’s still on for Saturday morning at the community center. I’ll let you know what’s needed as soon as I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be ready Saturday morning at the community center. Just send me the list when you’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — what’s still missing for the repair drive? I can help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and see what’s still needed. If you hear of anything specific, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll keep my ears open too, and let me know if you find any gaps.
